scheduler_adapter.scope: Per native measured request. Full first GX launch audit additionally identifies CUB DeviceCompactInitKernel as part of omitted nonzero operation: 3 launches/request. Additional scalar-read/CPU bookkeeping omission not quantified. Comparison and preceding-stream wait retained. Not an exact-replay claim.

attachment_controls.cause_observed: DynamoRIO failed to take over all worker threads; worker exit40. Earlier worker init attach also fails. Existing GX report proves setproctitle can invalidate saved DR environment; Omni invokes it before worker initialization. Testing skip of optional cosmetic title with original late attachment. No timing result from failed captures.

title_skipped_control.limitation: Chrome predictor inventory was not flushed by spawned worker; timing screen only, no native launch inventory audit. Explicit shutdown flush added for candidate comparison.

negative_screen.candidate: Direct pinned destination for component D2H offload
negative_screen.decision: No material modeled gain; no mode3 or A100 performance validation scheduled
negative_screen.limitation: Worker interval excludes IPC/client postprocessing; no numerical check for this unselected patch.

metadata_probe.finding: For 16B,1MiB,16MiB tensors in this Torch2.11 GX stack, nonblocking D2H already returns pinned CPU memory and subsequent pin_memory retains the data pointer. Blocking D2H returns unpinned storage and pin_memory allocates another. This explains the negligible selected-framework change; no native speedup claim.

limitations: Mode 2 client and worker clocks are independent. Worker markers exclude IPC packing and client postprocessing; client mode-2 intervals are not end-to-end latency. Mode 3 provides separate whole-client request intervals.
This is CPU submission/wait scheduling: mode-2 CPU instruction cost is nearly unchanged, while overlap improves. It is not reduced transfer traffic or model compute.

GX skips Euler initial-index nonzero/scalar-read operations, retaining comparison and preceding-stream wait. Three identified omitted CUB launches total 17.407 us/request in the native calibration; omitted scalar-read and CPU bookkeeping are not quantified. Native runs retain the original lookup and verify index zero.
GX and native can choose different cuDNN plans; malformed/missing signatures contribute zero predicted compute. Launch-count coverage is not time coverage or exact native replay.
CPU calibration has 11003 resolved and 2365 unresolved instruction samples (17.69% unresolved). GX host EPYC 7702P differs from native A100 host EPYC 9554.

GX cannot validate numerical output. Native checks finite returned float32 video and exact paired hashes, for one prompt, seed, shape, single GPU and serial requests. Training, concurrent parameter mutation and HSDP are not validated.

GX timing skips only the optional cosmetic worker process-title change to avoid a DR environment-relocation attachment failure. Explicit trace export occurs during worker shutdown, outside request markers.

reproduction.note: Install pinned dependencies, apply patch to pinned vLLM-Omni, adjust host/asset paths. Shared launcher and audit utilities are in this repository.
